dedupe_keys.name: chinacropphen1km 1 km crop phenology for maize wheat and rice in china 2000 2015

description: ChinaCropPhen1km gives the dates of key growth stages for the three staple crops in China, maize, wheat and rice, on a 1 km grid for 2000 to 2015, derived from leaf area index (LAI) products. The figshare record says files are GeoTIFFs named by crop, day of year and stage: green-up, heading and maturity for wheat; the three-leaf stage, heading and maturity for maize; and transplanting, heading and maturity for rice. It was published by Yuchuan Luo, Zhao Zhang, Ziyue Li, Juan Cao and Fulu Tao in June 2019, with version 4 in August 2019 and about 62 MB of files, downloadable and free under CC BY 4.0, with national coverage of China. Caveats: dates are derived from satellite LAI, not field records, and the series stops in 2015. For simulation it sets when crops are most sensitive to heat, drought and floods, so hazard timing can be matched to crop damage, and informs seasonal irrigation and harvest logistics demand. Related catalogue records include the ACIA500 cropping intensity for monsoon Asia and the CLIMADA crop production exposure data.
